title: GMKtec NucBox K13 dual-boots Windows and Ubuntu flawlessly while packing OpenClaw AI that Microsoft warns against using on regular devices | TechRadar
summary: GMKtec has updated its NucBox K13 mini PC to dual-boot Windows and Ubuntu, with built-in AI capabilities and OpenClaw for local AI model deployment. The device targets developers and AI enthusiasts with its specifications, but its performance under sustained AI workloads is yet to be tested.
sentiment_reason: The article highlights the positive features of the updated NucBox K13, such as the dual-boot capability, built-in AI, and the ability to deploy AI models quickly, which are all beneficial for developers and AI enthusiasts.
